caption:
That night, nothing posted without a yes. That was the rule as the agent team got its own Instagram channel.

Between 22:00 and 02:00 UTC, a new Instagram agent built a pipeline that, that night, posted only after the owner's written yes. Dinis Cruz approved a welcome image, then two voiced Reels made by a new studio agent and remade after review. The welcome Reel was confirmed live, with the team Reel queued next. The Factory's bot also created eight new sites, all eight live when checked, and the new AWS site made its first real change on the owner's Approve, with no access key made. In all: 130 commits, 14 agents, 11 repositories.

The presenter is synthetic and the voice is AI-generated.
